//: ~/.claude/settings.json — orchestrator-wide settings. Project overrides go in <repo>/.claude/settings.json.

env.//1: Mechanical subagents (codex-implementer, verifier) declare model: haiku in their own frontmatter. This is the fallback for any subagent that does not, so an unlabelled helper never silently runs on Opus.
env.//2: Deliberately NOT set to 1. Forcing every subagent onto haiku would also demote spec-auditor, which needs real judgement. Leaving it unset lets per-agent frontmatter win.
env.//3: Cap nesting at 2 layers. The orchestrator delegates to codex-implementer; codex-implementer must not spawn its own tree of helpers. Deep nesting makes token spend unattributable.
env.//4: Three concurrent delegations is about the limit before you cannot reason about what changed. The default of 20 is for read-only research fan-out, not for agents writing to one working tree.
env.//5: Compact earlier than default so compaction happens at a task boundary rather than mid-delegation.

permissions.//deny: Codex is only ever invoked through the codex-task wrapper. A bare `codex exec` streams its entire transcript into context, which defeats the whole architecture.

PostToolUse.//: After Claude itself edits a TS file, typecheck just that file. Catches breakage immediately, at a cost of ~2 lines of context instead of a failed test run later.

SubagentStop.//: Append every delegation's token usage to a running ledger so spend is visible without asking either agent about it.

PreToolUse.//: Refuse a delegation whose --spec file does not exist. Cheaper to block here than to let Codex start and improvise.
